captions.detailed: A classic counterbalance spring-arm desk lamp featuring a heavy, dark rectangular base with rounded corners. The adjustable arm consists of three dark-colored articulated links connected by pivot joints, each reinforced with a small tension spring. The lamp head is a dark green conical shade housing a light bulb, attached via a final rotatable joint allowing it to tilt.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery Python script for an articulated counterbalance spring-arm desk lamp. The model must feature a solid rectangular base, three interconnected arm links with pivot joints and tension springs, and a dark green conical lamp shade with an internal light bulb, all connected via revolute joints.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining several key parts: a base, multiple arm links, and a lamp head. The base is created using a rounded box. Each arm link is built using boolean combinations of cylinders (for pivots) and boxes (for structural bars), including helical spring sweeps. The lamp head is modeled using a hollowed-out cone (or truncated cylinder) with an internal sphere representing the bulb. These parts are then registered as visual assets in an ArticulatedObject and connected sequentially using revolute joints with specified rotation axes.
